description: This file defines the AdbDevice class, representing a USB device supporting the adb protocol, managing USB endpoints, socket communication, and message handling.

classes.name: AdbDevice
classes.description: Represents a USB device supporting adb protocol, manages communication endpoints, sockets, and message dispatching.

classes.name: WaiterThread
classes.description: Inner thread class that continuously waits for USB requests from the device and processes incoming messages.

methods.name: AdbDevice
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the AdbDevice with activity context, USB connection, and interface, sets up endpoints.

methods.name: getSerial
methods.description: Returns the serial number of the USB device.

methods.name: getOutRequest
methods.description: Retrieves an OUT UsbRequest from the pool, creating a new one if necessary.

methods.name: releaseOutRequest
methods.description: Returns an OUT UsbRequest back to the pool.

methods.name: getInRequest
methods.description: Retrieves an IN UsbRequest from the pool, creating a new one if necessary.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the WaiterThread and initiates connection.

methods.name: openSocket
methods.description: Opens a new socket to a specified destination, manages socket pool.

methods.name: getSocket
methods.description: Retrieves a socket by its ID.

methods.name: socketClosed
methods.description: Removes a socket from the active sockets list upon closure.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Sends a connect message to establish communication with the device.

methods.name: handleConnect
methods.description: Handles the response to the connect message, verifies device state.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Signals the WaiterThread to stop execution.

methods.name: dispatchMessage
methods.description: Dispatches incoming messages based on their command type to appropriate handlers or sockets.
